title: General.
officialText:
Supply, return, exhaust, relief and ventilation air plenums shall be limited to uninhabited crawl spaces, areas above a
finished ceiling or below the finished floor, attic spaces and mechanical equipment rooms. Plenums shall be limited to one fi re area.
Fuel-fired appliances shall not be installed within a plenum.
